verdict.rationale: Bitwarden's integrated authenticator documents automatic TOTP generation, and its authenticator import supports reading a Google Authenticator QR code. However, no evidence documents scanning a new account's setup QR code to start generating codes right away; the QR flow shown is a migration import. missing for 10: explicit documentation of scanning a site's setup QR code to add a new account, hands-on or independent corroboration of that flow.

support.subject: As an everyday user, I can scan a QR code and immediately start generating TOTP codes for a new account

citations.quote: it automatically produces the time-based one-time passwords (TOTPs), six-digit codes using SHA-1 that rotate every 30 seconds
Google Authenticator (QR code): Import from Google Authenticator using a QR code
